In the [[geometry]] of [[Hyperbolic space|hyperbolic 3-space]], the '''cubic-icosahedral honeycomb''' is a compact uniform [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]], constructed from [[icosahedron]], [[cube]], and [[cuboctahedron]] cells, in an [[icosidodecahedron]] [[vertex figure]]. It has a single-ring Coxeter diagram, {{CDD|label5|branch|3ab|branch_10l|label4}}, and is named by its two regular cells.

{{Honeycomb}}
